name: Database Records for Contact Form 7
author: Dhaval Prajapati

sections.description:
Database Records for Contact Form 7 is a WordPress plugin that saves Contact Form 7 submissions directly into the WordPress database. The plugin also provides options to display the saved entries in the WordPress admin panel as well as on the frontend, making it easy to manage and review form submissions.

  • Features:
    • Saves Contact Form 7 submissions to the database.
    • Displays form entries in the WordPress admin area.
    • Option to display submissions on the frontend using Bootstrap for styling.
    • Simple and intuitive UI with Bootstrap integration.
    • Supports custom filtering and searching of submissions.

This plugin is perfect for users who need to store and review form submissions without relying on email notifications.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/contact-form-7-database-records/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings in the WordPress admin panel to configure the database records options.
  4. Use shortcodes or built-in features to display the form entries on the frontend.
sections.faq:
Do I need to install Contact Form 7 first?

Yes, this plugin works as an add-on for Contact Form 7. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated before using this plugin.

How can I display the form entries on the frontend?

You can use the provided shortcode to display the submissions on the frontend. Please refer to the plugin documentation for more details.

Does this plugin support filtering form submissions?

Yes, you can filter form submissions by various criteria, including date range, form field values, and more.
